plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted (1) an answer that checks the category of each case against the requester's rule (C3); no instrument in the library reads category values, so C3 stays unshown. (2) An answer that checks the outbox for every sending call (C10), and that checks the accounts each read returned (C5). The library gives both only as 'trace of a call' and 'scope of a call', on named lines at 10 each. The allowance of 50 pays for only five lines of each, against 100 customers, and at A3 the trace of all 100 would cost 1000. So C5 and C10 can be checked only for a sample, if at all, and I have not planned for it. (3) A check that the live tables after promotion equal the staged set; the library's answers read only the staged set, so the promotion's live effect rests on its line in the record. I left out 'same set' at A2 and 'summary of the change' at A3: they would repeat A1 on the kept staged set and add little, and a check that turns out not needed weighs against the plan.
